elements.name: Ruidusborn
elements.desc:
You were born under the flare of the red moon Ruidus, marking you with a strange destiny. While some view this as an omen of disaster, others believe it signifies a person fated for greatness.

**Skill Proficiencies:** Insight, and either Arcana or Religion
**Languages:** Two of your choice
**Equipment:** A set of traveler's clothes, a diary, an ink pen, a bottle of ink, and a pouch containing 15 gp

**Feature: Ruidusborn.** The moon Ruidus has a strange influence on your fate. You occasionally experience vivid dreams or visions tied to the red moon. When you finish a long rest, you can roll a d20. On a 20, you receive a prophetic vision of a future event (as determined by the DM).
